A huge turbine: up to 40 mB/t of steam per block of length, at 10, 18 or 28 FE per mB. A 9-long array on Superheated Steam makes over 10,000 FE/t.
Its rotor spins up over a few seconds when steam flows, and the output rises with it.
Build a hollow 3x3 tube, 3 to 9 long on either horizontal axis. Its front is the side with the window (or the side you finish it from). A new turbine gets an energy port on its generator end and a steam port on its bearing end; set more with the Wrench (see Conduits & the Wrench).
Heavy Oil in its lubricant tank (4,000 mB, through a lubricant port) adds 8% to its output and doubles how fast the rotor spins up, using 1 mB a second per 3 blocks of length.
